content: Discord supports application-owned emojis (app emojis): up to 2000 custom emojis uploaded to a bot application via Developer Portal, usable anywhere on Discord. Custom emojis render in embeds/messages via <:name:id> format. discord.py 2.5+ exposes fetch_application_emojis(); Discord official emoji resource documents application emoji endpoints. Bots with 1000+ emoji typically keep a manifest (JSON of key->emoji ID) and render by constructing the <:name:id> string; the manifest can be checked into the repo rather than fetched at runtime.
